description: Suppressed/provenance-only parse nodes may remain in the audit graph, but must never participate in canonical semantic execution, point-status determination, or false RESOLVED inference.

mandatory_metrics.definition: Count semantic_suppressed=true nodes appearing in executable_argument_node_ids.
Count cases where semantic_suppressed=true node status changes point-level RESOLVED/UNRESOLVED aggregation.
Count RESOLVED relations whose canonical success depends on a suppressed node or suppressed-only path.

violation_handling: Do not patch the individual point first.
Inventory every occurrence across the active cohort/full dataset.
Determine whether the same structural pattern repeats.
Determine whether source semantics or canonical execution is actually affected.
Promote to a blocking defect family only when promotion criteria are met.
If promoted: defect family -> validator contract -> negative test -> full regression.
promotion_criteria: WHO/source semantics is actually lost or transformed.
The issue can produce false RESOLVED or an incorrect coordinate.
The same structural failure repeats across independent source expressions.
A frozen semantic-contract invariant is violated.
non_blocking_by_default: suppressed parser residue outside executable graph
diagnostic node with no canonical execution/status effect
